name: Toki Rangi
strength: Cold-nerved: vacuum, wrecked seals, tumbling sleds — none of it spikes his pulse
flaw: Trusts a machine before he trusts anyone with a chain of command
desire: Enough scratch to ride the Beanstalk back up to the Luna docks
ideal: Once a Loony, always a Loony
features: Moon-pale complexion; old suit-burn scar along the left jaw
gear: space suit (personal, patched at the knees)
favors: The Leyport Wharfmen's Mutual will lend a hand once if the Local hears he's in trouble
Owes Dockmaster Aguarui a favour on the fuel-ring skim

talents.name: Durable
talents.desc: Reduce any Critical Injury result suffered by 10 (min 01). Core Rulebook p73; suggested talent for Roughnecks.

notes: Born Leyport, Heinlein — third-generation moon-born. Four years pushing ore sleds on the Luna–L1 run, then a tow-certificate scare after a hauler he scanned turned out to be Melange contraband; blamed for it, blacklisted from the Heinlein dock crews. Came down the Beanstalk on a merchant berth and took gate work in New Angeles. Free archetype ranks: Coordination 1. Career perk ranks (Roughneck): Piloting, Operating, Vigilance, Athletics (+1 each, before XP).
